availability_note: Sootopolis after the Cave of Origin, Rain Badge not earned. Tapu Koko/Zapdos (Route 110 / New Mauville signs, reachable legends, gate 30), Iron Hands (New Mauville 30), Kartana (Petalburg Woods 20), Raging Bolt (Route 119, 60), Amoonguss (42). Nothing from Ever Grande or the League.

attempts.note: Koko Thunderbolt OHKOed Golduck T1 and Quaquaval T2; Iron Hands Drain Punch OHKOed AV Empoleon; Kartana Leaf Blade OHKOed Basculegion, Wild Charge OHKOed Milotic. Lost Koko to Empoleon Hydro Pump (T2) and Kartana (120 HP) to Samurott-H Band Sucker Punch (T4).

strategy_checks.check: Quaquaval opens with Aqua Step / Protect vs the Fake Out threat
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Quaquaval Protect blocked Iron Hands' Fake Out (real payoff); T2 it chose Aqua Step into Koko but Koko's Thunderbolt KOed it first.

strategy_checks.check: Golduck attacks or Nasty Plots; Cloud Nine present
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Golduck chose Hydro Pump into Koko, fainted to Thunderbolt before moving. Cloud Nine had nothing to cancel.

strategy_checks.check: Empoleon Competitive not triggered by the player
strategy_checks.evidence: No stat drops offered; Empoleon Hydro Pump OHKOed Koko (215/238) T2, then died to Drain Punch.
Milotic entered T3, chose Muddy Water, was OHKOed by Wild Charge before end-of-turn Flame Orb activation. The concept never appeared on the board.

strategy_checks.check: Basculegion Specs closer, Samurott-H Sharpness/Sucker Punch
strategy_checks.evidence: Basculegion chose Shadow Ball (died first); Samurott-H T4 Sucker Punch KOed Kartana (correct read on an attacking Kartana).

theme_note: Room concept (three self-boosting mechanisms, no weather) barely showed: every member died the turn it entered or the turn after. Only Quaquaval's Protect-into-Aqua-Step line and Samurott's Sucker Punch registered.
level_changes_unverified: None. Won with 2 faints per the brief's keep rule, but the fight lasted 3 turns; the room is soft against Electric Terrain + Grass. If the main agent wants the room to bite, +1 Golduck/Milotic would be the first lever.
cooler: The idea is good but the bodies are too frail for cap 84 against Tapu Koko: Golduck and Quaquaval both die to one Life Orb Thunderbolt. A Sitrus/Assault Vest Golduck or a Wide Guard user would let Aqua Step actually snowball. Not changed this pass.
